newsitem.title: USA: Eyeware shrs sink on Sunglass Hut warning.
newsitem.headline: Eyeware shrs sink on Sunglass Hut warning.

text.p: Sunglass Hut International Inc's warnings of disappointing third quarter profits sent its stock, and that of other industry players, reeling Thursday.

Sunglass Hut shares lost 4-1/4, or almost 32 percent, to 9-1/4 and fell to a new 52-week low of 9. The stocks has tumbled to about a quarter of its value from March, when it reached within a hair of 37.

Oakley Inc shares lost 4-1/8, or nine percent, to 41, and Gargoyles Inc shares lost three to 16-3/4. Gargoyles shares fell as low as 14, a new low for the company, which went public only a few weeks ago.
The stock had its rating cut this morning by two brokerage firms, Morgan Stanley and Alex. Brown & Sons.
